Hard frame: 33 India accommodation nights, arrival DEL 19 Dec 10:15, departure DEL 21 Jan 12:20.

## HARD PRESENTATION RULE
Every A/B/C visit location is written as `NAME (plain-language what it is / why it matters) — grade`.
No bare Indian place names as decision labels.

- 19 Dec: Delhi — 1 night
